system.flavor:
Lock one person in ice to the knees, freeze a lock solid, ice a doorway shut, make a plank bridge too slick to cross, or walk through a burning room with frost on your coat.

Not enough to freeze a river or hold anyone past the scene.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Cold Damage and make it Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn. Independently, reduce your next incoming Fire Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: One willing ally within 2 units gains the same Fire protection.
On a hit, the target must burn 1 die before voluntarily moving until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Water Thread
rider.html: Gain a Water Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: suppress one ordinary Movement penalty on yourself or one willing target of that card until the start of your next turn.
